text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":12,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"12 oranges"},{"id":"q2","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"three daughters"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"2 oranges each"},{"id":"q4","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"her only boy got 3 oranges"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q2","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"multiply number of daughters (3) by oranges each received (2) to find total oranges given to daughters"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"add the oranges given to the boy (3) to the oranges given to daughters"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"subtract total oranges given away from the original 12 to find how many Jennifer has left"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"oranges Jennifer has remaining"},"dismissed":[]}
